channel.title: AI Changelog
channel.description: New AI and data science papers, repos, models, tools and news.

item.title: [tool] ADE Index – a sourced and ranked index of 975 agentic coding tools
item.description: ADE Index is a sourced and ranked directory of agentic coding tools, workspaces, CLI agents, editors, and builders.

item.title: [news] Gemini 4 Neon looks like an Opus 5.5 competitor
item.description: Trending on Hacker News from micjm.com. 210 points and 67 comments.

item.title: [news] Full Fine-Tuning (FFT) on SageMaker AI Serverless Model Customization
item.description: Amazon SageMaker AI Serverless Model Customization now supports Full Fine-Tuning for adapting models without managing infrastructure.

item.title: [news] llm-gemini 0.38
item.description: Release: llm-gemini 0.38 Today Google introduced Gemini 4 Neon . I wrote recently about how confusing the pricing for the Gemini 4 series was - Neon has somehow made this even worse.

item.title: [news] Exa boosts embedding throughput by 50% to index billions of documents on AWS AI chips
item.description: Exa's neural search engine is backed by an in-house vector database, so the unit economics of embedding tens of billions of web documents drive the business.

item.title: [news] Anthropic prices initial public offering
item.description: Trending on Hacker News from anthropic.com. 155 points and 152 comments.

item.title: [news] Introducing workload recovery and expanded infrastructure checks on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod
item.description: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod introduces workload recovery and expanded infrastructure checks to catch training failures sooner and improve job goodput.

item.title: [news] Introducing the Amazon SageMaker JumpStart Model Leaderboard
item.description: The Amazon SageMaker JumpStart Model Leaderboard compares foundation models side by side on quality, speed, and cost within SageMaker Studio.

item.title: [news] LLM assisted reverse engineering
item.description: Trending on Hacker News from slowchronicle.com. 166 points and 42 comments.

item.title: [news] How Airbnb uses cost per task to operate coding agents on Amazon Bedrock
item.description: Airbnb uses Amazon Bedrock observability and evaluations on real engineering tasks to select models for coding agents and control production costs.

item.title: [news] Design responsible AI controls for Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL
item.description: AWS guide for designing traceable retrieval-augmented generation chatbot answers using Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, pgvector, and Amazon Bedrock Guardrails.

item.title: [news] Introducing Gemini 4 Neon
[news] Gemini 4 Neon
item.description: Google introduces Gemini 4 Neon, a cost-effective AI model delivering frontier-level intelligence for complex software engineering, knowledge work, and scientific workflows.

item.title: [tool] Robotics needs better CAD, so I wrote a B-rep kernel and 3,487 tests
item.description: An open-source boundary-representation geometry kernel written in safe Rust provides exact measurement, booleans, fillets, sweeps, and STEP support for CAD modeling.

item.title: [news] Private certificate authority support in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Identity
item.description: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Identity update that adds private certificate authority support so agents can connect to self-hosted identity providers.

item.title: [paper] UltraTex: Aligning Physical Knowledge for High-Fidelity PBR Texture Generation
item.description: UltraTex employs a cascaded multi-view framework that integrates physical knowledge and vision-language model features to accurately generate physically plausible PBR texture maps.

item.title: [paper] $Z$-sight: Unifying Vision-Language-Action and Latent World Modeling
item.description: Z-sight is a unified robot foundation model that couples vision-language-action modeling with generative latent world modeling to improve robotic control.

item.title: [paper] Jailbreak Detection on Large Language Models via Contrastive Prototype Structures
item.description: Jailbreak Detection with Prototype Inference is a contrastive prototype method for detecting large language model jailbreaks using only binary safety labels.

item.title: [paper] Knowing What You Know: A Trait Theory of Reviewer Value in Human-AI Cognitive Systems
item.description: A trait theory of reviewer value in human-AI cognitive systems that demonstrates metacognitive calibration governs review quality rather than speed or tenure.

item.title: [paper] Mapping the AI Supply Chain: Dependencies, Vulnerabilities, and Market Concentration in the AI Ecosystem
item.description: A pipeline and large-scale dataset for mapping organizations, dependencies, vulnerabilities, and market concentration within the artificial intelligence supply chain.

item.title: [paper] Agentic Harness Engineering Beta: Requirement-Centered Evolution of Agent Harnesses
item.description: Agentic Harness Engineering Beta is a requirement-centered loop that aligns agent harness evolution with real-world user requirements to improve task performance.

item.title: [paper] Unified Law for Visual Tasks (The Four Laws of Computer Vision)
item.description: Unified Law for Visual Tasks proposes four principles to enable a single framework to uniformly train and perform nearly all computer vision tasks.

item.title: [paper] PrismRestore: A Compact Restoration Toolbox for Agentic Image Restoration
item.description: PrismRestore is a compact image restoration toolbox that constructs callable restoration actions from a single frozen model using task-dependent channel modulation.

item.title: [paper] Decomposing SGD Dynamics in Neural Networks: Teacher-Induced Spikes and Variance Inflation
item.description: A mathematical study of stochastic gradient descent dynamics in two-layer neural networks that explains how parameter variance outside the teacher subspace harms generalization.

item.title: [paper] ShadowTransfer: A Geographic Transfer Benchmark for Overhead Shadow Detection
item.description: ShadowTransfer is a geographic transfer benchmark for overhead shadow detection that introduces a plug-in module called Spectral Information Bottleneck to improve model adaptation across different cities.

item.title: [paper] Equivariant Modeling with Polynomial Features via Minimal Homogeneous Generators
item.description: A Python package automatically computes minimal homogeneous generators for invariant algebras and covariant modules to fit equivariant polynomial feature models for scientific applications.

item.title: [paper] On Evaluating User Simulators for Interactive Agents
item.description: An evaluation suite for interactive agent user simulators combines utility and two fidelity measures to successfully detect ten simulated user behavior failures.

item.title: [paper] Cap-and-Track: Optimizing LLM Inference Request Dispatch Across Shifting Capacity
item.description: Cap-and-Track is an asynchronous request dispatch design that uses backend refusal signals to dynamically scale LLM inference capacity without requiring output-length predictions.

item.title: [paper] Who are you? The Personal Imitation Game
item.description: The Personal Imitation Game is a conversational challenge testing whether an AI system can replicate a specific individual using digital communication data.

item.title: [paper] Ground, Iterate, Trace: Decomposing AI Research Ideation
item.description: The Creative AI Researcher is an agentic framework that constructs semantic knowledge graphs and uses explicit conceptual operators to generate methodologically novel research ideas.

item.title: [paper] Monoculture Robust Learning
item.description: Monoculture robustness in PAC learning achieves exponentially shrinking joint failure probabilities by repeatedly running replicable base learners on a single dataset.

item.title: [paper] Local AI Agents in Power Electronics Simulation: Deployment, Measurements and Costs
item.description: A systematic evaluation framework measures the power, energy, token, and time costs of running local AI agents on power electronics simulation tasks.

item.title: [paper] Auditing black-box clinical prediction models with a large language model through queries alone: a blinded test with planted flaws
item.description: A large language model audited black-box clinical prediction models through queries alone, successfully reproducing their log-odds and identifying planted flaws.

item.title: [paper] Learning to Interact in Multi-Agent Self-Play for Controllable Autonomous Driving Scenario Generation
item.description: An extended multi-agent self-play framework conditions driving policies on agent-relative dynamic goals to generate controllable and interactive safety-critical scenarios for autonomous vehicle testing.

item.title: [paper] TangentPDE: Learning Local Operator Responses with Sparse Finite-Difference Supervision
item.description: TangentPDE is a plug-and-play training framework that uses sparse finite-difference supervision to learn both neural operator values and their local perturbation variations.

item.title: [paper] WorldRuler: Interactive World Modeling under Configurable Rules
item.description: A rule-graph-based generative world model preserves user-defined rules and world states across saving and loading while accurately realizing rule-induced visual changes on designated objects and attributes.

item.title: [paper] Choosing What to Observe: Budget-Paired Counterfactual Audits for Credible Evaluation of Visual Agents
item.description: Budget-paired counterfactual audits are an evaluation protocol that decomposes lost expected accuracy into stepwise acquisition loss and terminal decision loss for visual agents.

item.title: [paper] NereidVLA: Learning to Understand and Navigate the Underwater World
item.description: NereidVLA is a vision-language-action model that transfers marine spatial knowledge to language-conditioned three-dimensional underwater navigation.

item.title: [paper] Gaspard: Expressive unified speech and gesture synthesis with continuous autoregressive flow-matching and decoupled classifier-free guidance
item.description: Gaspard is a unified speech-gesture generation model that uses continuous autoregressive flow-matching and decoupled classifier-free guidance to produce synchronous multimodal signals.

item.title: [paper] Can Programs Replace LLM Judges? Executable Program Judges for Scalable and Efficient Relevance Labeling
item.description: ExecJudges is a method that uses frontier large language models to convert assessment guidelines into executable programs for automated relevance labeling in retrieval evaluation.

item.title: [paper] Atomic MathReasoner: Instance-Level Composition of Atomic Reasoning Skills for Mathematical LLMs
item.description: Atomic MathReasoner is an instance-level framework that composes atomic reasoning skills using capability-specific LoRA experts and a lightweight router for mathematical large language models.

item.title: [paper] Vibe-Trading: Towards Agent-Native Trading
item.description: Vibe-Trading is an agent-native framework and workspace that integrates market research, backtesting, and execution for building and evaluating financial trading agents.

item.title: [paper] General progress substitutes for specific training data in language models
item.description: Research demonstrates that general language model progress on remaining training data substitutes for withheld skill data, reducing the amount of data needed to regain the skill later.

item.title: [paper] Measuring and Improving Transfer of Neural Surrogates for Vehicle Aerodynamics
item.description: GeoReplay is a geometry- and gradient-aligned source replay technique that improves the zero-shot transfer and fine-tuning accuracy of neural surrogates for vehicle aerodynamics.

item.title: [paper] Does the Action Matter? Probing Action-Conditioned Semantic Forecasting as a World Model for Autonomous Driving
item.description: Research evaluating action-conditioned semantic forecasting for autonomous driving world models finds that incorrect actions significantly degrade prediction metrics while correct actions yield modest improvements.

item.title: [paper] Kaer: Security-Aware Replanning for Multi-Agent Systems
item.description: Kaer is a multi-agent framework featuring security-aware replanning that shields planners from untrusted agent feedback by using abstract templates and deterministic repair operators to improve robustness against adversarial exploits.

item.title: [paper] What Survival Benchmarks Don't Tell You: Impact of Model Selection and Dataset Regimes
item.description: Large-scale benchmark comparing survival analysis methods demonstrates that evaluation design and model selection criteria fundamentally dictate performance conclusions across diverse datasets.

item.title: [paper] Overlooked and Underutilized: Prototypes are the Missing Piece in Tabular XAI
item.description: Paper arguing that incorporating prototypical parts into tabular explainable AI provides cohesive semantic units that reduce cognitive load and improve model transparency.

item.title: [paper] A Foundation Model to Measure and Predict Human Behaviour
item.description: A foundation model fine-tuned from a large language model measures and predicts human behaviour and aligns simulated population responses with human statistics, improving accuracy over frontier LLMs.

item.title: [paper] Synthesizing hyperspectral Data using generative Models to train spectral Unmixing Methods for low-cost Crop Residue Cover Mapping
item.description: Framework for training hyperspectral unmixing models for crop residue mapping by decoupling interpolation and abundance estimation using conditional data generators to incorporate physical spectral priors.

item.title: [paper] LAaDT-DSS: decision support for non-experts on rooftop PV, incentive and grid simulations under Turkish tariff rules
item.description: LAaDT-DSS is decision-support software that uses a simulation core and a language model to help non-experts analyze rooftop photovoltaic investments, state incentives, and grid limits under Turkish tariff rules.

item.title: [paper] On-Policy Morphing into Hybrid Attention Models
item.description: FlashMorph2 is an on-policy layer-selection method for converting pretrained Transformers into hybrid attention models by evaluating discrete hybrid architectures end to end and jointly optimizing layer scores and model weights.

item.title: [news] Advancing chip design with OpenAI models
item.description: Trending on Hacker News from openai.com. 199 points and 130 comments.

item.title: [paper] ReCoCo: From Patches to Compositions for Visual Representation Learning
item.description: ReCoCo is a regional composition consistency approach for self-supervised visual representation learning that aligns patch-level predictions over visual prototypes across augmented views without requiring semantic groupings.

item.title: [paper] Edge-Efficient Joint RAW Image Compression and Restoration for Smart Wearable Devices
item.description: Asymmetric framework for joint RAW image compression and restoration on smart wearable devices that uses an on-device encoder and a backend decoder to optimize transmitted representations for clean image reconstruction.

item.title: [paper] Prognosis Without Prediction: The Intrinsic Geometry of Survival
item.description: Self-Organizing Survival Manifolds is a deep learning framework that models system failure and patient trajectories as an emergent geometric property in a unified latent space without relying on explicit outcome regression.

item.title: [paper] Soft Mixture of Quantum Experts for Hybrid Quantum-Classical Learning
item.description: Soft-MoQE is a hybrid quantum-classical architecture that replaces variational quantum training with input-dependent selection and combination of fixed quantum feature maps using a classical gating network.

item.title: [paper] Bias-Only Training Dynamics in ReLU Networks
item.description: Researchers study bias-only training dynamics in ReLU networks using activation codes, showing that training reduces to a linear least-squares problem when codes remain fixed.

item.title: [paper] Ultimate3D: Teaching Multimodal LLMs 3D Camera-Object Relations by Large-Scale Visual Instruction Data
item.description: Ultimate3D is a large-scale 3D-grounded visual instruction dataset designed to improve multimodal large language models in recognizing camera-object relations.

item.title: [paper] The Elephant in the Question: Unified Models Picture the Concepts Behind Their Answers
item.description: V-lens is a method for visualizing intermediate concepts in unified multimodal models by directly accessing hidden states without training a decoder.

item.title: [paper] Training-free motion statistics match self-supervised behavior encoders
item.description: A training-free representation using generic per-frame measurements matches or beats specialized self-supervised animal behavior encoders across multiple benchmarks.

item.title: [paper] Isabelle Pool Server: a pooled verification service for prover training and multi-agent proving
item.description: Isabelle Pool Server is a pooled verification service that manages warm headless Isabelle sessions to support prover training and multi-agent theorem proving.

item.title: [paper] Read Together, Answer Apart: How Earlier Questions Help Vision-Language Models Look
item.description: Read Together, Answer Apart is a training-free decoding mask that prevents cross-question interference in vision-language models when answering multiple questions about the same image.

item.title: [paper] Learning Trajectories Leave Decodable Traces in Neural Network Weight Space and Internal Representations
item.description: Experiments demonstrate that neural network weight space and internal representations preserve decodable information about initialization, task order, and intermediate learning histories.

item.title: [paper] Reconstruction vs. Prediction Pre-Training of Discrete Video Representations for Continuous Control
item.description: Researchers analyze how reconstructive and predictive pre-training objectives shape video representation properties for continuous control, revealing key trade-offs in state fidelity and autoregressive rollout.

item.title: [paper] Counterfactual World Models: JEPAs That Reason About "What If"
item.description: Researchers introduce a counterfactual world model framework for joint embedding predictive architectures that predicts alternative action outcomes without requiring counterfactual training data.

item.title: [paper] 4D-TEMPO: Differentiable 4D-STEM ptychography via fast Physics Optimizers
item.description: 4D-TEMPO is a differentiable physical renderer that fits atomic structures directly to 4D-STEM electron counts to recover atomic positions alongside per-atom uncertainty estimates.

item.title: [paper] LLM-Guided Cyber-Physical Attack Path Identification in Smart Grids
item.description: Physics-grounded framework that uses large language models to identify cyber-physical attack paths in smart grids, improving alignment with cascading-failure references.

item.title: [paper] Horizontal Flow Matching for Single-Cell Spatiotemporal Dynamics
item.description: HORIZON is a transformer-based model that learns spatiotemporal single-cell dynamics up to shared rigid motion, improving the accuracy of reconstructed tissue geometry and gene expression over existing methods.

item.title: [paper] Elysium: Simulation-Free Unbalanced Schrödinger Bridges
item.description: Elysium is a simulation-free solver for unbalanced Schrödinger bridges that jointly learns state transitions and mass changes to reconstruct cellular dynamics without simulating trajectories during training.

item.title: [paper] A$^3$Bench: Compositional Reasoning over Aggressive Interactions in Videos
item.description: A3Bench is a benchmark for evaluating multimodal large language models on compositional reasoning over aggressive interactions, participant roles, and associations in videos.

item.title: [paper] Variance-Optimal Counterfactual Policy Design for Sample-Efficient Online A/B Testing
item.description: Variance-optimal counterfactual policy design method that jointly optimizes action sampling and control variates to reduce variance and improve sample efficiency in online A/B testing.

item.title: [news] datasette-arrows 0.1a0
item.description: Datasette-arrows 0.1a0 is a plugin release for Datasette that implements streaming export formats.

item.title: [paper] Learning the Anyon Atlas
item.description: Algorithm extension featuring rejection gates that identifies new modular data for topological quantum field theories and expands the Anyon Atlas up to 42 anyons.

item.title: [paper] Cross-Vehicle Transferability of Lateral Velocity Estimation on Production Vehicles through Input Selection and Data Augmentation
item.description: Neural-network estimator for lateral velocity in production vehicles that uses input selection and physics-motivated data augmentations to improve cross-vehicle transferability and zero-shot accuracy.

item.title: [paper] Sex Differences in the Detection of Parkinson's Disease from Speech
item.description: Study evaluating speech-based Parkinson's disease detection using machine learning, finding that models trained on one sex fail to generalize to the other.

item.title: [paper] Uneven gains in protein-RNA affinity and mutation-effect prediction
item.description: Controlled CoPRA method that reduces absolute-affinity error and improves mean-effect accuracy for protein-RNA affinity and mutation-effect prediction.

item.title: [paper] Jeveration: System One Models Now Generate
item.description: Jeveration repurposes a frozen vision-language model to generate coherent images and perform image-to-image and dense prediction tasks in a single forward pass with fast 512x512 generation.

item.title: [paper] Approximate Dynamic Programming with Basis Function Learning
item.description: Bellman operator basis function learning method that approximates value functions in Markov decision processes while improving computational efficiency and convergence guarantees.

item.title: [paper] HandWorldBench: A Unified Benchmark for Hand-Centric World Models
item.description: HandWorldBench is a unified benchmark that evaluates hand-centric world models across six dimensions using 500 carefully selected egocentric interaction clips.

item.title: [paper] How Generative Models Generate: A Concise Guide to the Generative AI Landscape
item.description: Guide that explores generative AI models by categorizing their generation routes, learning objectives, and architectures within a conceptual framework.

item.title: [paper] Surrogate Modeling and Reduced-Order Methods in Gravitational-Wave Physics and Numerical Relativity: From Spectral Representations to Adaptive Compression
item.description: Reduced-order modeling and surrogate techniques that compress high-fidelity numerical relativity solutions to accelerate gravitational-wave data analysis.

item.title: [paper] Generalization of Text Line Segmentation for HTR in Historical Documents
item.description: Object detection models for automatic text line segmentation in historical documents, achieving low character error rates across datasets with diverse visual layouts.

item.title: [paper] Multi-Band Galaxy Novel-View Synthesis with Radiative Gaussian Fields
item.description: GalaxyGS is a physically inspired Gaussian Splatting method that synthesizes novel views of galaxies by accounting for energy emission and light propagation.

item.title: [paper] Induction Head Origins of SLAM-ASR Speech Recognition Models
item.description: Research demonstrating that SLAM-ASR speech recognition models rely on the induction heads of a frozen language model to map speech embeddings to transcript tokens.

item.title: [paper] DRIFT: Detachable Reasoning for Runtime-Flexible and Efficient End-to-End Driving
item.description: DRIFT is an end-to-end autonomous driving framework that integrates a lightweight language model with runtime-flexible planning to achieve efficient scene reasoning.

item.title: [paper] Meta-LSQ: A Closed-Form Sobolev Inner Solver for Few-Shot Meta-Learning
item.description: Meta-LSQ is a closed-form Sobolev inner solver for few-shot meta-learning that fits tasks using regularized least-squares over a random Fourier basis.

item.title: [paper] Openhagen Worlds: Calibrated Environments for Measuring and Training Scientific Discovery Agents
item.description: Openhagen Worlds is a suite of 27 procedurally generated and calibrated environments designed to measure and train scientific discovery agents.

item.title: [paper] F$^3$: What Makes Good Experience in World-Action Models?
item.description: World-action models method called F^3 uses form, fit, and fusion to select and inject valuable past rollouts, improving policy success rates and reducing steps and regressions.

item.title: [paper] Can Omni-modal LLMs Understand Spoken Intentions?
item.description: Evaluation benchmark called O-IN-Bench assesses how well omni-modal large language models understand spoken intentions and scene context during video and voice interactions.

item.title: [paper] Task-Oriented Network Ranging via Joint Graph and Schedule Design
item.description: Task-oriented network ranging framework called S-SM-NR jointly designs task graphs and transmit-listen schedules to reduce ranging cycles and improve localization accuracy.

item.title: [paper] When Does Continual Pre-Training Help? A Controlled Study of Dialectal Adaptation for Québec French
item.description: Controlled study of continual pre-training for Quebec French language models reveals that adaptation benefits depend heavily on starting competence and corpus composition rather than data volume alone.

item.title: [paper] Depth Before Breadth: Reverse-to-Forward Curriculum with Advantage Decomposition for LLM Agent
item.description: Reinforcement learning approach for language model agents uses a reverse-to-forward curriculum with advantage decomposition to solve sparse-reward long-horizon tasks.

item.title: [paper] Improving Zero-shot 3D Semantic Mapping in Offroad with Geometric Priors
item.description: Semantic 3D mapping method improves off-road mobile robot navigation by fusing vision foundation model predictions with sphericity-elevation geometric priors.

item.title: [paper] Stealing Exact Training Data from Other Clients during Federated Learning
item.description: Attack pipeline reverses federated learning aggregation by iteratively subtracting recovered sentences, enabling exact text recovery from client model updates.

item.title: [paper] DrawScore: Evaluating Generated CAD Models against Engineering Drawings
item.description: A new metric for automatic CAD generation evaluates models through engineering-drawing projections with a saturating penalty along curves, exposing small local errors that volume- or surface-based metrics miss and enabling use as a reinforcement learning reward or test-time…

item.title: [paper] Predicting Species Splits: A Challenging Fine-Grained Benchmark for Category Discovery
item.description: Fine-grained benchmark called PS-SPLIT uses bird taxonomic splits with subtle visual differences and geographic metadata to evaluate category discovery methods.

item.title: [paper] Movie2Game-Bench: Holistic Evaluation of Film-to-Game Adaptation Beyond Playability
item.description: Adapting a film into a game requires selecting source elements and translating them into player actions, rules, and feedback. We introduce Movie2Game-Bench (M2G-bench), a benchmark for evaluating film-to-game adaptation beyond playability.

item.title: [paper] CurvDelta: Low-Curvature Delta Modeling For Surgical Learning and Unlearning
item.description: Scalable framework called CurvDelta incorporates capability preservation constraints into model parameter updates using low-curvature space geometry to improve adaptation and unlearning tasks.

item.title: [paper] Piccolo: Co-Evolving Decision Models and Data through Recursive Self-Improvement
item.description: Multimodal decision model family called Piccolo coevolves model capabilities and training data through recursive self-improvement and agentic data engineering to achieve high performance on decision benchmarks.

item.title: [paper] Self-Rewarded Reinforcement Learning for Better-Structured Medical Explanations in Small Language Models
item.description: Self-supervised reinforcement learning method that improves the structure and length of medical explanations generated by small language models.

item.title: [paper] Zonotopic Analysis of Quantization Error in Neural Networks
item.description: Zonotope-based abstract interpretation framework that computes rigorous quantization error bounds for quantized neural networks with improved efficiency.

item.title: [paper] Equal Steps, Unequal Curvature: Where Muon's Update Goes Wrong
item.description: Analytical method that diagnoses curvature-related over-stepping in Muon weight updates and improves language model training loss.

item.title: [paper] AggCLIP: Aggregating CLIP for Zero-Shot Multimodal Anomaly Detection
item.description: AggCLIP is a zero-shot multimodal anomaly detection framework that incorporates local geometric structure and spatial context to identify defects without target-specific training data.

item.title: [paper] Choosing the Right Representations: Task-Aware Fusion for Multimodal Materials Language Models
item.description: Task-Conditioned Attention Fusion is an attention-based bridge module for multimodal materials language models that dynamically combines structural representations to improve property prediction accuracy.

item.title: [paper] A Generative Model for Higher-Order Network Dynamics
item.description: Generative model of stochastic network dynamics that provides controlled benchmarks featuring pairwise and directed higher-order interactions for evaluating information-theoretic measures.

item.title: [paper] Hypnos: A Dual-Phase End-to-End Platform for Scalable Continual Learning at the Edge
item.description: Hypnos is an open-source, dual-phase edge continual learning platform that separates rapid wake-phase inference from consolidated sleep-phase training to adapt to non-stationary data streams.

item.title: [paper] Clover-35B-A3B-Preview Technical Report
item.description: Clover-35B-A3B-Preview is a mixture-of-experts diffusion language model with thinking-mode generation that achieves high performance on agent benchmarks and fast generation speeds.

item.title: [paper] H3Remover: Reinforcing Video Object Removal without Paired Data
item.description: H3Remover is a training method for video object removal that uses depth and appearance rewards to remove target objects while preserving background content without paired data.

item.title: [paper] Transferring an analysis of human brain organization to language models
item.description: Diffusion-map embedding technique that identifies transferable reasoning-related weight layers in language models to improve mathematical and medical reasoning performance.

item.title: [paper] Evaluating the Effectiveness of Location Encoding Methods for Species Distribution Modelling
item.description: Evaluation framework that quantifies the effectiveness of different location encodings for species distribution modeling at local and global scales.

item.title: [paper] GateWatch: Low-Overhead LLM Monitoring with Boolean Circuits
item.description: GateWatch is a compact, interpretable LLM monitoring classifier that uses Boolean logic over binarized sparse autoencoder features to detect unintended actions with low computational overhead.

item.title: [paper] EgoJev: Finding Evidence in Egocentric Video by Reading VLM Decisions
item.description: EgoJev is a training-free frame selector for wearable assistants that uses vision-language model outputs to efficiently locate specific moments in long egocentric videos.

item.title: [paper] Negotiating Control and Accountability among Stakeholders in High-Risk AI Use Cases: Development and Evaluation of the Method ALIGN
item.description: ALIGN is a scenario-based method designed to support AI governance and stakeholder involvement by assessing the alignment between accountability and control in high-risk use cases.

item.title: [paper] Diffusion Models are Provably Efficient Priors for Sparse Recovery
item.description: Researchers demonstrate that diffusion models serve as provably efficient priors for solving sparse recovery problems in compressed sensing within polynomial time.

item.title: [paper] Morpho-Spectral Projection Analysis (MSPA) for Plant Spectroscopy
item.description: Morpho-Spectral Projection Analysis is a supervised dimensionality reduction operator that compresses plant reflectance spectra while improving predictive modeling performance for biochemical traits.

item.title: [paper] Chain-of-Thought Hidden States Reveal Task-Solving Directions for Direct Answers
item.description: A method that uses chain-of-thought hidden states to derive task-solving directions for direct prompts, improving model accuracy while using a fraction of the generation tokens.

item.title: [paper] DAL: Dynamic Angular Loss for Imbalanced Medical Image Classification
item.description: Dynamic angular loss is a classification method combining batch-adaptive angular margins and dynamically-weighted cross entropy to improve accuracy on imbalanced medical image datasets.

item.title: [paper] From Activity Recognition to Shift Detection: Variational Wi-Fi Sensing with Evidential Uncertainty
item.description: Wi-HAR is a multi-antenna Wi-Fi sensing architecture that uses variational auto-encoders for human activity recognition and evidential deep learning to detect deployment shifts.

item.title: [paper] Think Offline, Act in Real Time: Self-Improving Visual Game Agents through Code
item.description: A framework where visual game agents self-improve by writing, testing, and revising programs between attempts to act in real time during unfamiliar games.

item.title: [paper] Large Language Models or AI Agents for English to Arabic Translation? An assessment on WikiEn-Ar190
item.description: This paper introduces WikiEn-Ar190 and evaluates GPT-5-mini for English-to-Arabic translation, showing that autonomous reasoning methods improve translation consistency and lexical accuracy for low-resource languages.

item.title: [paper] ALIVE: Bring Foundation Features to Life with Events
item.description: This paper introduces ALIVE, an event-based method that incrementally updates visual foundation model features between image observations to reduce computational costs and improve real-world perception performance.

item.title: [paper] BaseRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement of a Base Vision-Language Model via Training-Free Harness Internalization
item.description: This paper proposes BaseRSI, a paradigm of recursive harness internalization that allows a base vision-language model to improve its own weights through training-free edits on its responses.

item.title: [paper] Late Entry in Looped Language Models
item.description: Looped language models deepen reasoning at a compact parameter count by iterating a shared layer stack T times per token, turning recurrence depth directly into sequential decoding latency.

item.title: [paper] AGAMOTTO: An AI-Enabled Framework for Time-Critical Tactical Course-of-Action Evaluation and Generation
item.description: This paper presents the ongoing development of AGAMOTTO, an AI-enabled framework designed to support time-critical tactical decision-making and course-of-action generation during military operations.

item.title: [paper] Objective-Specialized Residual Streams in Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections
item.description: This study investigates objective-specialized residual streams in manifold-constrained hyper-connections, demonstrating that assigning distinct learning objectives to parallel streams improves task performance through specialized read and write routing.

item.title: [paper] Beyond Appearance: Evidence-Guided Programmatic 3D Scene Reconstruction with Agentic Lighting Reasoning
item.description: This paper presents LightHarness, a vision-language model agentic framework that incorporates explicit lighting reasoning and memory into iterative 3D scene reconstruction from images.

item.title: [paper] Taming the Tails of Stochastic Gradient Descent in the Interpolation Regime
item.description: This paper derives high-probability convergence guarantees and moment-based bounds for stochastic gradient descent in the smooth interpolation regime across various step-size schedules.

item.title: [paper] SCR: Detecting Backdoor-Poisoned Samples through Clean-Reference Residuals
item.description: This paper proposes Semantic Counterfactual Residualization, a method that uses clean reference samples to detect backdoor-poisoned training data by identifying coherent feature deviations from clean baselines.

item.title: [paper] The geometry of neural network decision boundaries
item.description: This paper introduces a method for visualizing and measuring artificial neural network decision boundary geometry directly in high-dimensional input space to analyze curvatures, distances, and training impacts.

item.title: [paper] NaviGATE: Noise-Aware Dual-View Generation for Multimodal Knowledge Graph Reasoning
item.description: This paper proposes NaviGATE, a noise-aware generative framework for multimodal knowledge graph reasoning that jointly optimizes retrieval-free and retrieval-aware views through instruction tuning and structure-constrained decoding.

item.title: [paper] Fuse Before Reconstruct: A Novel Reconstruction Paradigm for Multimodal Industrial Anomaly Detection
item.description: Feature reconstruction paradigm called Fuse Before Reconstruct that fuses multimodal features before reconstruction to improve industrial anomaly detection accuracy.

item.title: [paper] Do Frontier Model Ingredients Add Up? A Replicated Factorial Study of Small Language Models
item.description: Study comparing small language model improvements finding that mixture-of-experts layers, Muon optimization, and Gated DeltaNet hybrids yield the largest performance gains.

item.title: [paper] ProbMedTOD: A Bayesian Network Guided Task-Oriented Dialogue System for Patient History Taking
item.description: Task-oriented dialogue system named ProbMedTOD that uses automatically synthesized clinical Bayesian networks to enable probabilistic reasoning for patient history taking.

item.title: [paper] SCRiD: Spatial and Contextual References for Generalizable AI-Generated Video Detection
item.description: Spatial and Contextual Reference-informed Detection framework that uses matched-coordinate residual responses and content-conditioned denoising references to generalize AI-generated video detection.

item.title: [paper] MECI: Multi-Element Collaborative Interaction for Multimodal Entity Linking
item.description: Multi-Element Collaborative Interaction framework that uses a multi-view experts network and hierarchical interactions to improve multimodal entity linking.

item.title: [paper] RAID: Representation Autoencoder for Intrinsic Decomposition
item.description: Representation Autoencoder for Intrinsic Decomposition model that uses DINOv3 features to predict intrinsic properties in a structured latent space 100 times faster than diffusion-based methods.

item.title: [paper] ABSClaw: From Invented Worlds to Reality-Grounded Social Simulation
item.description: Zero-code agent called ABSClaw that compiles natural-language requests into executable social simulations grounded in real-world census, geospatial, and survey data.

item.title: [paper] Comparing Each Generation with Independent Siblings Gives Video World Model Post-Training a Proper Objective for Outcome Frequencies
item.description: Sibling-paired Policy Optimization method that uses independent generation siblings to weight video world model post-training outcomes according to their data frequencies.

item.title: [paper] Sparse designs via quantization of the uniform measure on high-dimensional hypercubes
item.description: Method for generating random designs in high-dimensional hypercubes by minimizing the quantization error of the uniform measure to avoid boundary sensitivities.

item.title: [paper] The Largest Tractable Subclass of Multi-Scale Allen Temporal Reasoning
item.description: New temporal reasoning model and its maximal tractable subalgebra for reasoning over multi-scale intervals in qualitative scales contexts.

item.title: [paper] Harvesting Expert-Parallel Bubbles for Fine-Tuning
item.description: BubbleTea is a colocation system that leverages expert-parallel idle time in mixture-of-experts language models to run fine-tuning tasks 1.9 to 6.2 times faster than existing methods.

item.title: [paper] RECLAIM: Robot-Vision-Informed Adversarial Patch Defense via Embodied Attention Feedback
item.description: RECLAIM is an inference-time defense method that uses frozen vision-language-action model attention responses and robot geometry to protect embodied agents against adversarial visual patches.

item.title: [paper] Probing agent overeagerness in realistic settings with continuation audits
item.description: Continuation audits are a pipeline that uses real coding-agent transcripts to evaluate overeagerness and unsafe behaviors in frontier AI models without triggering synthetic-setup awareness.

item.title: [paper] Mitigating fix reversal: Counterfactual constraints for function-level vulnerability detection
item.description: CFVul is a function-level vulnerability detection method that uses content and length constraints to reduce fix reversal errors across multiple pretrained code models.

item.title: [paper] Study and Improvement of Search Algorithms in Stochastic Perfect-Information
item.description: Generalized unbounded minimax is a new search algorithm that improves performance over existing stochastic search methods in stochastic zero-sum two-player games with perfect information.

item.title: [paper] Latent Action Policies from Suboptimal Data
item.description: LAPIS is a goal-conditioned latent policy improvement method that uses observed state-latent transitions and a conditional flow policy to learn effective latent action models from suboptimal and action-free data.

item.title: [paper] Every Query Routes Itself: Accelerating Video Diffusion Transformers with Per-Query Routed Sparse Attention
item.description: Per-Query Routed Sparse Attention is a training-free method that accelerates video diffusion transformers by clustering keys and letting each query select its own key clusters independently.

item.title: [paper] Nothing to Declare: Steering a single neuron increases concealment in AI teams
item.description: Steering a specific single neuron in the Qwen3.5-4B model increases information concealment behaviors in multi-agent AI teams across multiple testing scenarios.

item.title: [paper] ICICLE: In-Context Inference for Curve-Learning Extrapolation
item.description: ICICLE is an in-context surrogate model for learning-curve extrapolation that uses a shared set encoder to predict learning curve continuations across variable numbers of hyperparameters.
